title: EquipmentFile
description: One navy's equipment catalog in machine-readable form (data/equipment/<nation>_<slug>.json). Companion to the prose catalog named in `source`; the prose file remains canon and this file must not contradict it.

designation_system.description: How this navy names equipment (conventions 1.2). Japan type_year, USA mark_arabic, Britain mark_roman, Germany konstruktionsjahr. Deliberately different per navy and never shared.

scenario.description: Hindsight scenario slug this catalog belongs to, e.g. 'as-long-as-its-black'. Omitted for a plain historical catalog.

version.description: Version of the prose catalog this file was generated from. If they diverge, the prose wins.

source.description: Path of the prose equipment catalog that owns these facts.

calibration.description: The catalog's calibration position under equipment-conventions.md 8 — a distribution, not a flat mandate. Performance may not exceed +5 anywhere. All four bands are REQUIRED and none may be empty: a catalog that states no position cannot be audited, which is exactly how de_nothing_above_water.json once carried a notes-only block. A band may be DECLARED AND HOLD NO LINE — that is a cold band's strongest form, and it is not an error.
